blocks.text: The Philippines is on a quest to secure its position as the most successful Asian country at the 2026 Miss International pageant, pinning its hopes on Binibining Pilipinas Katrina Anne Johnson. This year, the Japan-based international pageant is holding its 64th edition, and is returning to the Tokyo Dome City Hall, now called Kanadevia Hall, for the Final Gala. The culminating event will be held on Nov. 25, and will be streamed on the Miss International YouTube channel in real-time at 5:30 P.M. (4:30 P.M. in Manila).
